scope: Static local scene state and metadata guards only; no physical services or scientific outputs.

authority.fixture_instance_id: Locally generated non-authoritative namespace prevents accidental cross-instance receipt replay; not authentication.

identity.specimen_version: Strict positive integer; bool, floats and strings are rejected. No physical state-altering version service is implemented.

Consume marker; advance mount and state revisions; reset terminal labels to unknown

transitions.effect: Consume safe-zero and invalidate prior continuity; advance state and netlist revisions
Consume marker; preserve identity/retention and invalidate continuity

transitions.guard: New current exact safe-zero fixture marker
transitions.effect: Consume marker; preserve identity/retention and invalidate continuity

transitions.guard: Current exact unused continuity fixture marker; unique record ID
transitions.effect: Store metadata and metadata hash only; consume continuity marker

transitions.guard: Exact sample ID/version/carrier; retained is strictly True
Known C01-C10 and unique acknowledgement ID
transitions.effect: Fixture acknowledgment only; resolved remains false; qualification gate remains true

netlists.source_locator: Main Fig4b; SI FigS26b/c identifies left BG and right TG
netlists.qualification_gate: Independent circuit/pad-map review must verify actual source/drain and gate assignment; diagram-derived topology is not a PCB netlist.

netlists.source_visual_interpretation: S1 driver with one to nine distinct stacked loads in parallel; verify every gate connection against original schematic and approved pad map. No electrical connection is inferred solely from the word parallel.
netlists.qualification_gate: Full gate and pad mapping for each selected load set required.
Separate TG1 and TG2 sources, terminal references and physical pad-map verification required; do not reuse ordinary-inverter gate shorting.

parallel_S30_status: Unsupported by scene rewire: no full approved gate/pad map is available; no connection inferred from parallel.

always_rejected.entrypoint: request_service (any name or payload) and any action outside apply allowlist

metadata_record.hash_scope: JSON bookkeeping metadata only, never measurement evidence

conflicts.title: Buffer thickness
conflicts.source_difference: Main Methods p775 states 25 nm between stacks; main p773, SI TableS1 and Section7 state or prefer 50 nm.
conflicts.required_handling: Qualified material card must name selected source variant and rationale. Neither value becomes the default.

conflicts.title: Printed current ratio
conflicts.source_difference: Main Eq1 prints ION/IOFF = ID,OFF / ID,SAT, conflicting with ratio prose and large reported ratios.
conflicts.required_handling: No ratio computation until an independently approved equation disposition is supplied. Never silently invert.

conflicts.title: Printed mobility
conflicts.source_difference: Main Eq2 prints mobility = L/(W Ci) * dID,lin/dVG without an explicit drain-voltage factor.
conflicts.required_handling: Dimensional and definition review required before mobility calculation; do not substitute a conventional formula silently.

conflicts.title: Printed subthreshold swing
conflicts.source_difference: Main Eq3 visibly prints d(log10 ID)/dVG minus 1 as a baseline subtraction, not a reciprocal.
conflicts.required_handling: Keep the printed expression in the conflict ledger only; require an approved metric definition before SS analysis.

conflicts.title: Mobility population scope
conflicts.source_difference: Headline maximum is 15 cm2/V/s; TableS2 lists DG 15.86±0.29 and 16.64±0.28; separate 100-device cohort reaches 19.72.
conflicts.required_handling: Keep cohort-specific outcomes. No global maximum or merged success threshold.

conflicts.title: Threshold sign and narrative ranges
conflicts.source_difference: Main DG range begins +0.31 V; TableS2 S9 is −0.31±0.17 V. BG/TG narrative ranges also differ from table entries.
conflicts.required_handling: Retain narrative and table evidence separately; no sign normalization or invented statistical resolution.

conflicts.title: Cohorts and uncertainty
conflicts.source_difference: Baseline N=12 per stack across three chips/four systems; reliability and transient 100 per architecture; long-term SI says 50 devices without clear per-architecture allocation. Main broadly groups them under 100.
conflicts.required_handling: Separate cohort IDs and qualified long-term allocation; ± remains undefined, never assigned SD or SEM.

conflicts.title: Coupling caption
conflicts.source_difference: FigS25 caption repeats BG2-to-BG1 for iii/iv; Section7 and panels identify TG1-to-BG2 and BG2-to-TG1.
conflicts.required_handling: Preserve both interpretations; no coupling execution without reviewed terminal-map disposition.

conflicts.title: Surface label
conflicts.source_difference: FigS7 stack7 BG appears as 251±1.66 nm; Section4 states layer RMS no more than 4 nm.
conflicts.required_handling: Retain literal anomaly; do not silently turn 251 into 2.51 or adopt it as a process target.

conflicts.title: Leakage magnitude
conflicts.source_difference: Main p772 describes DG leakage near 1e-12 A; SI Section6 p39 describes 1e-10 A as safe.
conflicts.required_handling: Bind leakage to actual curve, cohort and bias; never zero leakage or a universal acceptance threshold.

limitations: No geometry, collision, IK, reachability, contact, electrical, thermal, fabrication or wirebond validation is implemented by these guards.
Fixture markers are caller-owned synthetic metadata, not authenticated independent environmental measurements.
A guard pass is never permission to use hardware. No real safe state or physical continuity is established.
All ten source conflicts remain unresolved qualification gates despite any fixture acknowledgements.
